title.use: Opening card. Big headline with a short line under it.

params.kicker: 2 to 4 words, shown small above the headline
params.headline: 3 to 7 words

website.use: A real website shown in a browser frame, scrolling down the page. Use when the story is about a site, product or page.

params.title: 3 to 6 words naming what we are looking at
params.scroll: 0 to 1, how far down the page to scroll (default 0.6)

photo.use: Full bleed stock photo with a slow push in and a headline. Use for real world context: people, places, objects.

params.headline: 3 to 7 words
params.focus: optional [x, y] in 0..1, where the subject is

assets.query: 2 to 4 concrete visual words, no abstract ideas

orb3d.use: A glossy 3D object in motion next to a headline. Use for abstract ideas, a big claim, or a change of pace.

params.headline: 3 to 6 words
params.color: optional hex colour for the object

bullets.use: A heading and 2 to 4 numbered points revealed one by one. Use for lists, steps or reasons.

outro.use: Closing card with a headline and a call to action pill.

params.headline: 3 to 6 words
params.cta: optional, a URL or 2 to 4 words
